title: Prototype pollution

blocks.md:
## Do not merge untrusted keys onto Object.prototype

`obj.__proto__` or a merge of `{ "__proto__": { polluted: true } }` can change **every** object. A JSON body from outside the desk is not a safe field list.

Safe dictionaries: `Object.create(null)`, or copy **own** keys and skip `__proto__`, `constructor`, and `prototype`. `Object.freeze(Object.prototype)` is a belt.

`safeMerge(target, src)` copies only those safe own keys. A fake heading `__proto__` in a fox log must not rewrite every object on the desk.

blocks.promptMd: When merging untrusted objects, skip {{a}} and {{b}}.
blocks.explainMd: Also skip prototype. Copy only ordinary own keys such as name onto a fresh object.

blocks.promptMd: > `safeMerge({}, { __proto__: { x: 1 }, name: "n" }).name` prints `n`. Hidden: prototype stays clean.

hintLadder.md: Start from a fresh object. Copy own keys from `src` one at a time.

description: Do not let outside data write into the shared object behind every record.
